goal: Improve causal noisy-signal and financial conditional-mean prediction, not merely a favorable optimizer proxy.

abstract_optimum.squared_loss_target: f*(x_t,H_t)=E[y_t|x_t,H_t], where H_t contains only observations available before the forecast.
abstract_optimum.resource_constraint: Compare prediction risk with actual learner state, update cost, and available history disclosed. Observation-matched gains do not imply equal-compute gains.
abstract_optimum.irreducible_uncertainty: For independent mean-zero observation noise, noisy MSE equals clean conditional-mean error plus noise variance in expectation. Weak-signal improvements can be large in excess risk and tiny in total MSE.
abstract_optimum.brain_analogy: Generate competing hypotheses about persistent memory, latent context, and prediction errors. Biological plausibility is not evidence of algorithmic correctness or performance.
abstract_optimum.epistemic_limits: Exact inference under a model is not optimal prediction under a misspecified data-generating process. No finite search certifies a global optimum. Zero may remain the best useful return forecast.

diagnosis.sparse: v3 sometimes keeps a good conditional coefficient while inclusion collapses. v4 periodic cohorts reduce sampled relapse but impose delayed replacement selection; birth-only post-change risk was 42.9% worse than v3-static.
diagnosis.finance: Panel explicit features omit the latest available bar. Simple persistence references are missing. SPY normalized-return gains lose to transformed raw-return zero. Prior gating, routing, and wider networks do not establish the missing mechanism.

sparse_experiment.primary: Nine-state causal global-segment posterior with persistent null state and top-posterior-mass compression.
sparse_experiment.hypothesis: Joint change-versus-continuation evidence can adopt a useful replacement without periodic erasure of established support.
mechanism_controls: frozen v4 birth-only and continual aggregation
sparse_experiment.selection: Noisy-prefix-only AdamW configuration selection; all fresh-confirmation configurations locked from development before fresh observations. Clean targets/support are scoring-only.
sparse_experiment.promotion: Require at least 20% lower change risk than frozen v3-static on fresh draws, without more than 5% stationary risk regression. Null safety is absolute excess risk <=1e-5 rather than a misleading ratio to nearly zero. Also compare tuned AdamW and publish every named arm, including failures.
limitations: Gaussian likelihood using causal scale estimate
global changes may not represent asynchronous drift
strong sparse prior is model information, not an optimizer advantage
one seed with fresh namespaces, not independent seed-level significance
